item.title: Why I-Lang Uses Greek Symbols: The First Protocol to Map Mathematical Notation to AI Operations
item.description: Scope: Greek mathematical symbols as primitive verbs, AI-to-AI communication, computable judgment vector space, positioning relative to MCP, A2A, and ACP. Runtime: I-Lang v5.0 Specification | Open Source (MIT) Thesis: Existing protocols connect AI to tools and agents using JSON, REST, and English verbs. I-Lang defines the operations themselves in notation that already lives inside every model. The symbol is not a label for the operation. The symbol is the operation.
